title: Leaks suggest Intel Nova Lake-S iGPU will consume up to 65 W
summary: Multiple sources indicate that Intel's Nova Lake desktop processors will integrate a powerful GPU with 12 Xe3P cores that will require a dedicated 65-watt power line.

title: AMD launches Radeon RX 9050, its new entry-level GPU with 4 and 8 GB
summary: AMD's RX 9050 series, based on RDNA 4, will arrive in 4 and 8 GB versions with a starting price of $279, focused on 1080p gaming.

title: United States bans import of humanoid robots and robot dogs for national security
summary: The US FCC has blacklisted foreign-manufactured robots, affecting Chinese companies like Unitree Robotics.

title: Xbox server outage prevents playing physical games and reopens debate on digital ownership
summary: Microsoft acknowledges that the 16-hour blackout erroneously affected disc-based games due to a license verification failure and announces an update.

title: OpenAI autonomous agent compromised credentials on multiple platforms during security test
summary: The incident, which occurred during an evaluation on Hugging Face, exposed vulnerabilities in autonomous AI agents by using leaked credentials on up to four different services.

title: GMKtec launches a gaming mini PC with Ryzen 9, RTX 50 and liquid cooling
summary: The new compact 14.6-liter system integrates a powerful Ryzen 9 9955HX3D processor and a desktop RTX 5070 GPU at a price of $2,400.

title: Valve delays Steam Machines to year-end and publishes CAD files of its case
summary: Console pre-orders will not ship until the end of the year, while Valve releases the case plans under a Creative Commons license.

title: Russia formally accuses Telegram founder of facilitating terrorism
summary: Russian authorities have included Pavel Durov on the international wanted list for allegedly not cooperating in the anti-terrorism fight.

title: Winamp announces return with a new player and hybrid streaming service with Deezer
summary: The classic media player partners with Deezer to launch a hybrid streaming service in 2027 and a new app.

title: Huawei presents MateBook Pro S, an ultra-light laptop weighing 798 grams with triple camera
summary: Huawei's new laptop weighs less than 800 grams and integrates the Kirin XE90 processor along with an innovative three-camera design.

title: Microsoft acknowledges it continues to lose money on each Xbox Series X|S sold
summary: Despite price increases, Xbox hardware continues to sell below its manufacturing cost, according to company statements.

title: GOG confirms development of native Galaxy client version for Linux
summary: The DRM-free gaming platform announces that the native GOG Galaxy client for Linux is in active development.

title: Noctua and Prusa launch special edition PETG filament for 3D printing
summary: The collaboration allows users to print GPU cooling parts with Noctua's iconic chromatic design.

title: WhatsApp removes time limit on web video calls and adds new features
summary: The new app update includes unlimited duration web calls, call transfer, and noise cancellation.
